steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: A rental listing gives short facts. Use a full question when you need one detail confirmed. Start with the number of rooms, then ask what is included.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.tip: Say it: eel yah uh(n) bahl-KOH(N)
